name: Avis Allen
source:
Avis Allen is a pleasant and respectable local resident of Lambeth and a patient of Doctor Forman. Despite being a Catholic, she is otherwise unremarkable- though not to [url=https://vndb.org/c120692]Simon Forman[/url]. For there is something special about Avis that Forman can't quite manage to put his finger on.

[From [url=https://www.astrologaster.com/]Official Website[/url]]
